sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: My request is two more account executives.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Our pipeline is up {PERCENT}, and the team can't follow up on every lead.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: {PERCENT}, really?

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: What's the cost?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: About the same as one senior hire.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: You can hire one now and the second next quarter if the pipeline holds.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: That works.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Why two more account executives?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The pipeline grew {PERCENT}, and we're dropping leads.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Huh, {PERCENT} is more than I expected.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: One now, and a second next quarter if the growth continues.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay, thank you.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Should we keep selling into the public sector?

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The sales cycle there is over a year, and we've closed two deals.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Those two deals are big, though.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: We continue, but with one dedicated person instead of the whole team.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Understood.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Public sector deals take more than a year, and we've only closed two.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Two very large ones.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Then one person focuses on public sector, and the rest of the team doesn't.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: That's fair.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'd like to change how commission works.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Right now reps are paid on signed deals, and churn in the first year is high.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Move part of the commission to after the customer's first renewal.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The team won't love it, but it's right.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Reps get commission at signature, and a lot of those customers churn in year one.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: So we reward the wrong thing.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Part of the commission should only be paid after the first renewal.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Okay.
